name: tomorrow is a brasilia day
description: The same rule with the clock at 23:00 on 2026-08-28 in Brasilia, which is already 2026-08-29 in UTC. Tomorrow is still 2026-08-29, so 2026-08-30 is still refused - a validator reading the UTC day would admit it, and the horizon it planned would be the wrong 24 hours.
